parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: DeleteSlb
parameters.description: Specifies whether to delete the SLB instance purchased for the gateway when you delete the gateway.

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the association record.

parameters.name: SlbId
parameters.description: The ID of the SLB instance that needs to be deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse delete-gateway-slb --id 395 --delete-slb true --gateway-unique-id gw-c9bc5afd61014165bd58f621b4910000 --slb-id lb-uf6duug6s13x4abc80000 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse DeleteGatewaySlb --region cn-hangzhou --SlbId 'lb-uf6duug6s13x4abc80000' --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-c9bc5afd61014165bd58f621b4910000' --AcceptLanguage zh --Id 395 --DeleteSlb true
